marketing_description: The VELUX FS Series Fixed Skylight, part number FS C01 2004S, features a wood frame with a pre-finished Gray/White finish, providing a low-maintenance aesthetic. This double-glazed skylight with laminated, Low-E3 glass offers natural daylight illumination and 99% UV protection. It also includes a built-in solar shade for glare control and a 1-Point Mortise lock for security.
